stated: The Conservative Party will prioritise women's health by bringing forward a national strategy for maternity care, delivering additional funding for maternal safety, improving access to mental health and perinatal pelvic health services, expanding women's health hubs, and rolling out fracture liaison services.

source.quote: We will prioritise women’s health, following publication of the first ever Women’s Health Strategy in 2022. To support women further, we will: Bring forward a comprehensive national strategy for maternity care... Deliver additional funding for maternal safety and improve access to mental health services for new mums... Expand women’s health hubs... Roll out fracture liaison services...

bearing_set.reason: The policy directly expands NHS healthcare access and capacity for women — maternity care, maternal safety, mental health, perinatal pelvic health, women's health hubs, and fracture liaison services all bear on whether women can get treated when they need it.

membership_note: This is a focused healthcare-access policy for women; the effects on other fundamentals (e.g. O12 via additional funding) are not quantified in the stated text and cannot be assessed as non-negligible without knowing the quantum and funding source. O9 is not in scope: the policy is a positive spending pledge, not an anti-discrimination or equal-treatment legal measure. Only O3 earns a genuine, non-negligible verdict.
